title: Getting Started with React
content: React is a popular JavaScript library for building user interfaces. It allows developers to create reusable components and manage application state efficiently.

title: Introduction to Playwright for QA
content: Playwright is a modern end-to-end testing framework that supports multiple browsers and provides powerful APIs for reliable test automation.

title: Understanding CI/CD Pipelines
content: CI/CD pipelines automate the process of building, testing, and deploying applications, helping teams deliver software faster and more reliably.

title: Why End-to-End Testing Matters
content: End-to-end testing ensures that all parts of an application work together as expected, reducing production bugs and improving overall software quality.
